about: Every package the UI may install (VELDO-0145 and VELDO-0131, applying VELDO-0131 AC4; VELDO-0229 adds Nuxt UI). Direct packages are listed with their exact registry version (taken on 2026-10-28 with npm view), license, origin and tier; every package of package-lock.json must carry an allowed license and match no denied name. The VELDO-0145 suite applies this file with control_api_ui.dependency_problems.

vaul-vue@0.4.1.evidence: The published package declares no license field; its repository github.com/unovue/vaul-vue (moved from Elliot-Alexander/vaul-vue, the repository the package names) carries the MIT LICENSE (GitHub license API, checked 2026-11-01 for VELDO-0229). A Nuxt UI dependency (its drawer), approved under the owner's dependency rule (Telegram 28929).

licenses.why_0BSD: 0BSD (tslib, a Nuxt UI dependency through its floating and table packages) is a public-domain-equivalent permissive license; admitted for VELDO-0229 under the owner's dependency rule (Telegram 28929).

deny.name: primevue
deny.reason: free and paid tiers: version 5 is under the commercial PrimeUI License with a free community tier, and the vendor sells paid add-ons around version 4 (dropped by the owner, VELDO-0145 round 2)

deny.name: @primevue/*
deny.reason: free and paid tiers: version 5 is under the commercial PrimeUI License with a free community tier, and the vendor sells paid add-ons around version 4 (dropped by the owner, VELDO-0145 round 2)

deny.name: @primeui/license-manager
deny.reason: free and paid tiers: the license manager of the commercial PrimeUI License

deny.name: @primeuix/themes
deny.reason: free and paid tiers: themes of the commercial PrimeUI line

deny.name: recharts
deny.reason: prohibited by the owner (VELDO-0131 AC4: shadcn charts and Recharts are explicitly rejected)

deny.name: shadcn
deny.reason: not in the owner's Vue stack (VELDO-0131 AC4, amendment 2026-11-01)

deny.name: shadcn-vue
deny.reason: not in the owner's Vue stack (VELDO-0131 AC4, amendment 2026-11-01)

deny.name: @vue-flow/*
deny.reason: not admitted (VELDO-0131, 2026-11-01): the workflow canvas is Veldo's own SVG control

dompurify.why: monaco-editor 0.57.0 pins dompurify 3.4.15, which has published advisories; 3.4.17 fixes them

@axe-core/playwright.tier: axe-core is free; Deque sells separate products, not a paid tier of axe-core
@axe-core/playwright.why: Accessibility checks from the real accessibility tree

@fontsource-variable/ibm-plex-sans.origin: Fontsource packaging of IBM Plex Sans (IBM, United States; drawn with Bold Monday, Netherlands)
@fontsource-variable/ibm-plex-sans.why: The one face for titles and interface text (normal width, variable weight)

@fontsource/ibm-plex-mono.origin: Fontsource packaging of IBM Plex Mono (IBM, United States; drawn with Bold Monday, Netherlands)
@fontsource/ibm-plex-mono.why: The record in the run terminal and the ids a person copies (dispatch ids, digests, fingerprints)

@iconify-json/lucide.origin: Iconify (Vjacheslav Trushkin) packaging of Lucide (community, github.com/lucide-icons/lucide)
@iconify-json/lucide.why: The local icon collection Nuxt UI's icons are bundled from at build time, so no icon is ever fetched from the Iconify API (VELDO-0229)

@nuxt/ui.origin: NuxtLabs (France; part of Vercel, United States, since 2025); github.com/nuxt/ui
@nuxt/ui.tier: free, no paid tier: Nuxt UI Pro was merged into the free MIT library in version 4
@nuxt/ui.why: The component library the owner chose (Telegram 38228, 38229 and 38234): UApp, UButton, UCard, UBadge, UAvatar, USwitch, through its Vite and Vue plugins (VELDO-0229). Its own dependencies (reka-ui, @vueuse/*, tailwind-variants and others) are approved by the owner's dependency rule (Telegram 28929), pinned by the lockfile

@tanstack/vue-table.origin: TanStack (Tanner Linsley, Utah, United States); github.com/TanStack/table
@tanstack/vue-table.tier: free, no paid tier (TanStack's tenets page: paid tiers none; it sells consulting and support, not a tier of the library)
@tanstack/vue-table.why: The backlog hierarchy table: expandable item and unit rows (VELDO-0131)

@types/node.why: Node types for the build config and browser tests

chart.js.origin: Chart.js organization (community maintained; github.com/chartjs/Chart.js); its one dependency @kurkle/color by Jukka Kurkela, Finland
chart.js.why: The usage over time chart, used directly without a wrapper (VELDO-0131)

monaco-editor.why: Read-only diffs of edits in the run terminal

tailwindcss.tier: the framework is free; the vendor sells separate UI kits, which Veldo does not use

typescript.why: Type checking (6.0.3: vue-tsc does not run on TypeScript 7)

vue.origin: Vue core team (vuejs organization), open source; the owner chose Vue (Telegram 37228)
vue.why: The UI framework the owner named
